description_en: Add a sharing configuration for data works
description_zh: 添加数据作品的一个分享配置
name: AddShareReport

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared work. The works here include BI portal, dashboards, spreadsheets, and self-service access
parameters.help_zh: 分享作品的ID。这里的作品包括数据门户，仪表板，电子表格，自助取数
parameters.name: works_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the person to be shared, which may be the user ID of the Quick BI or the user group ID.

If ShareToType is 0 (user), ShareTo is the user ID.
When ShareToType is set to 1 (user group), ShareTo is the user group ID.
When ShareToType=2 (organization), ShareTo is the ID of the organization
parameters.help_zh:
被分享者的ID，可能是Quick BI的用户ID，也可能是用户组ID。

ShareToType=0（用户）时，ShareTo为用户ID。
ShareToType=1（用户组）时，ShareTo为用户组ID。
ShareToType=2（组织）时，ShareTo为组织ID
parameters.name: share_to_id

parameters.help_en:
The share type of the template. Valid values:

0: user
1: user group
2: organization
parameters.help_zh:
分享类型。取值范围：

0：用户
1：用户组
2：组织
parameters.name: share_to_type

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the share. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 分享的有效期限，格式为毫秒级时间戳
parameters.name: expire_date

parameters.help_en:
The scope of authorization. Valid values:

1: view only
3: View and export
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型。取值范围：

1：仅查看
3：查看并导出
parameters.name: auth_point

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the interface is returned. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request fails
Result.description_zh:
返回接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
